verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.codegen.com (HTTP 200) that indexes docs pages as Markdown links. Multiple doc pages are served as .md files (e.g. cli.md, agent-behavior.md, agent-permissions.md), so an agent can consume them directly. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or bundled full-text variant, and first-party documentation describing or promoting agent-oriented docs consumption.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
